questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Which cooking oils are healthy and whether expensive ones are worth it
How to fry fish without oil
Why butter is better than olive oil
How olive oil is produced in Europe
questions.why: They find out whether expensive oils are worth the money and can help us eat more healthily.

questions.q: What does Georgie usually cook with?
options: Avocado oil for everything
Sesame oil for Asian food, and coconut oil for everything else
Olive oil for everyday meals, and butter for rich dishes
Coconut oil and butter
questions.why: She uses butter when she wants food rich and creamy, but usually olive oil for everyday meals.

questions.q: When does Neil sometimes use sesame oil?
options: When he bakes cakes
When he cooks East Asian food
When he roasts vegetables for dinner
When he makes salads
questions.why: Neil says for East Asian food he might sometimes use sesame oil.

questions.q: According to Neil, where does a lot of the fat we eat come from?
options: Chocolate, cake and other treats
Fast food restaurants
Milk and cheese
The oils we cook with
questions.why: He says lots of the fat we eat comes from the oils we use to cook with.

questions.q: What does listener Alastair's email show?
options: That advice about cooking oils is confusing and keeps changing
That most people fry food too often
That the YouTube doctor experts all agree with each other about oils
That sunflower oil is the healthiest choice
questions.why: He was told to use sunflower oil for years, but now online experts say seed oils are harmful.

questions.q: What has Alastair heard about extra-virgin olive oil?
options: It is much too expensive for most people to use in everyday cooking
It has no health benefits at all
It is the best oil for frying
It isn't good for frying and may become harmful when very hot
questions.why: He writes it's not suitable for frying fish and that over a certain temperature it turns harmful.

questions.q: What does Professor Nita Forouhi say about avocado oil?
options: It is bad for your health
It is the only oil that people should use if they want to stay healthy
It is good, but buy it only if you love the taste and can afford it
It is cheaper than olive oil
questions.why: She says it's good, but if you like the taste and have the money, 'knock yourself out'.

questions.q: What is Nita's opinion of claims about 'wonder oils'?
options: They are mostly true
They are mostly nonsense
They are true only for coconut oil
They need more research
questions.why: She says there are lots of myths about wonder oils and 'it's just all… hogwash'.
